usageTelemetryDescription: Controls server anonymous usage reports, server OpenTelemetry, server ZeroBus debug-log uploads, and standalone browser OpenTelemetry. Server export changes apply after a restart; reload the web app for browser changes. Host, runner, and CLI processes keep their own configured OpenTelemetry and ZeroBus destinations unless a deployment opt-out is set; embedded host analytics and vendor CLIs are governed separately. Automatic update checks (CLI PyPI / git origin and desktop update feed) fetch only a public version list with no usage data and stay outside this switch; disable them with OMNIGENT_NO_UPDATE_CHECK (CLI) or desktop update_mode "manual" / "none".
